title: Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) – ISACA
overview: The Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) course is designed to provide a comprehensive understanding of information security management and governance. This course prepares participants for the CISM certification exam by covering essential areas such as information security governance, risk management, and incident response.
audience: IT auditors, consultants, and risk managers.
Individuals preparing for the CISM certification exam.
Those interested in advancing their knowledge and career in information security management.
methodology: Lectures and Presentations: In-depth explanations of CISM concepts and domains.
Hands-On Labs: Practical exercises for implementing and managing information security measures.
Case Studies: Real-world scenarios to apply CISM concepts and solutions.
Group Discussions: Interactive sessions to explore security management challenges and best practices.
Quizzes and Practice Exams: Assessments to gauge understanding and readiness for the certification exam.
competencies: Information security program development and management
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: To provide a thorough understanding of information security management principles and practices.
To prepare participants for the CISM certification exam.
To equip learners with practical skills for managing and implementing information security strategies.
To familiarize participants with best practices and advanced concepts in information security management.
